title: Cattle mutilations done by humans

tellings.quote: Same thing with cattle mutilations. Linda Moon thinks those are aliens. No, we're doing that.

plain: The cattle mutilations, in which farm animals are found dead with parts cut away, are done by humans and not by aliens, according to a UFO activist named Steven Greer. He tells Michels this without naming a source, pushing back on the journalist Linda Moulton Howe, who he says "thinks those are aliens": "No, we're doing that." If he is right, people blaming aliens for the mutilations have been looking in the wrong place.
